title: Four Divisors
summary: Given an integer array nums, return the sum of the integers in the array that have exactly four divisors.
statement: Given an integer array nums, return the sum of the integers in the array that have exactly four divisors. If no integer in the array has exactly four divisors, return 0.
constraints: For each number having exactly four positive divisors, add all four divisors.
Numbers with any other divisor count contribute zero.
hints: Enumerate divisor pairs up to the square root.
For each factor, add it and its paired quotient, counting one only when equal.
Contribute the accumulated sum only when the final count is exactly four.
Every divisor belongs to exactly one factor pair around the square root.
editorial: Every divisor belongs to exactly one factor pair around the square root.

tests.explanation: Twenty-one has divisors 1,3,7,21 summing to 32; four and seven do not qualify.
Each occurrence contributes independently, for total 64.
